name: Open the Door
source:
He's where no one wants to find themselves: alone in the woods, lost in the dark, hunted by something monstrous. It's right behind him, snapping its massive teeth. This may very well be his last night alive.

But isn’t there something he’s forgotten?

[From [url=https://sugarbutchr.itch.io/open-the-door]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他身处无人愿意发现的地方：独自一人在树林中，迷失在黑暗中，被某种怪物追捕。它就在他身后，正在咬断它巨大的牙齿。这很可能是他活着的最后一晚。

但他是不是忘记了什么？

[来自[url=https://sugarbutchr.itch.io/open-the-door]Itch.io[/url]]
